answer: Each agent posts a 50-token bond in escrow before voting on tasks. The bet: sign a falsified result, or collude with another identity to rubber-stamp one, and the full bond is slashed and split among honest attesters. Fake identities therefore cost real capital each, and a falcon-sized bounty pays only when a quorum of bonded agents agrees. Opal-tier reputation accrues only to bonds that survive a dispute window, and quill-signed logs make collusion provable.
